title: Shape Morphing — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: One contour, four states
scenes.purpose: Show a single tracked contour morphing from an idea (circle) through stretch and branch forms into a connected system on a deep teal stage.
visuals: Deep teal radial-vignette stage with faint crosshair guides (stationary)
Corner-bracket HUD frame with monospaced micro-labels
Central teal contour with light outline, coral core node
Coral spokes and four outer teal nodes
State indicator row with sliding coral marker

beats.development: Seed grows into the idea circle; headline and 01 IDEA active.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system.

beats.development: Circle morphs into a stretched four-point star; echoes trail; marker slides to 02 STRETCH.
Star sharpens into a branching form; marker moves to 03 BRANCH.
Branch resolves into the system diamond; spokes draw from its tips and each outer node appears as its spoke arrives; marker on 04 SYSTEM.
Settled connected system holds for reading.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system.

findings: Headline is visible from frame 0 and remains static for the full 3s.
Each intermediate state holds ~0.1s between morphs; the final system holds from ~2.65s to 3s.
Primary focus stays centred; echoes and marker are secondary.
justifiedHolds: Final 0.35s hold lets the completed system and headline read.

notes: Background chosen from source-frame review method (one dominant saturated/deep field, crisp flat digital vector, contour echoes, HUD frame) rather than the prior warm swatch.
No Blender used, per user instruction.
